subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should existing oversized `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` workspace instructions be silently skipped at 1 MiB, or must the safety fix preserve their current loading contract until a supported recovery path exists?
rationale: This is a user-visible compatibility choice: the technical descriptor-bound read removes the TOCTOU concern, but it does not determine whether discarding established project instructions is an acceptable product behavior.

options.title: Preserve project context
options.body: Apply the bounded-read hardening to explicit prompt-input files and retain the existing project-context contract until a separately approved context-budget design exists.

options.title: Approve a hard context cap
options.body: Accept the 1 MiB project-context limit only with explicit owner approval, clear user-facing diagnostics, and proof that existing workspaces have a practical recovery path.

recommendation.title: Preserve project context
recommendation.body: Apply the bounded-read hardening to explicit prompt-input files and retain the existing project-context contract until a separately approved context-budget design exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current implementation and can incorporate the selected contract, while a current-main session-area owner should confirm the product direction.
